tldr: Saturn in Cancer: discipline must be learned through emotional foundations and care.
body: With Saturn in Cancer, the work is building inner security, mature boundaries, and a home within yourself that does not depend on everyone else being okay first.
gift: Emotional responsibility, protective strength, and the ability to create durable safety.
challenge: Defensiveness, emotional withholding, or carrying family weight that was never yours alone.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
